title: UPB at SemEval-2022 Task 5: Enhancing UNITER with Image Sentiment and Graph Convolutional Networks for Multimedia Automatic Misogyny Identification
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical challenge of detecting misogyny (a category of hate speech) in multi-modal memes using vision-language models like UNITER. While misogyny is a social and ethical issue, the study does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religious frameworks, spiritual traditions, or general philosophical ethics/morals.
